versions.changelog:
- Initial release of web-to-markdown skill.
- Convert any web page to clean Markdown for easier reading.
- Extract all image URLs from any website with simple commands or scripts.
- Batch-download images from web pages, with options for file type, size, and destination folder.
- Supports multiple conversion services (markdown.new, defuddle.md, r.jina.ai) with automatic fallback for reliability.
- Special handling for sites like Pinterest; works with dynamic and lazy-loaded images.
